subject: Proofpoint acceptance and rollback playbook — MAP milestones & tests
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Anita Rao <anita.rao@helixhealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proofpoint acceptance and rollback playbook — MAP milestones & tests

Hi Anita, Ben, Lauren,

Per our kickoff today, I put together a concise proposal for how we’ll define acceptance for the evaluation, the exit gates we’ll use to trigger a rollback, and the minimal evidence HelixHealth will need to sign off. The attached “MAP_criteria_draft.xlsx" contains:

- A small set of primary success signals (latency targets, P95, throughput at expected concurrency, and classification accuracy thresholds for PHI redaction).
- Three exit gates (critical safety failure, unacceptable latency regression, and data residency violation).
- Acceptance test definitions with quick run instructions (end-to-end smoke, load-oriented token-cost checks, and 10-case clinical concordance pass/fail).

Requests:
1) Can you confirm which of the three success signals you need as "must-pass" vs "nice-to-have"?
2) Can the Helix procurement team accept a 30-day rollback/contractual safety window if we hit an exit gate?
3) Availability: can we run the smoke + 10-case concordance on Tue 9/21 at 10:00am PT?

If that time works, Ben and I will run the tests and record the evidence in the shared folder. I also included a short rollback playbook in the sheet that enumerates the immediate mitigation steps and the ticket/SL escalation path.

Thanks — aiming to lock MAP milestones and sign-off flow this week so we can hit the pilot start date.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0128

Attachments: MAP_criteria_draft.xlsx
From: Anita Rao <anita.rao@helixhealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@helixhealth.com
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2027 12:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proofpoint acceptance and rollback playbook — MAP milestones & tests

Thanks Soojin — this is helpful. A few quick notes: 

- On "must-pass" vs "nice-to-have": clinical concordance (10-case) is a must-pass for our safety committee. Latency targets are important but we can accept a slightly higher P95 for the first 2 weeks if cost/throughput are otherwise satisfactory.
- Procurement: they need a defined rollback window in the contract; 30 days sounds reasonable but they asked for an explicit clause and a contact for emergency termination. I looped procurement on this thread.
- Tue 9/21 10:00am PT works for the smoke and concordance run. Could Ben also capture token/billing estimates during the run so procurement has an early cost picture?

Two asks for your team: can you add a brief traceability section in the MAP that links each acceptance test to the exact artifact evidence (logs, exported eval pdf, and matching run id)? We need that for auditability.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — talk Tue.

— Anita Rao
Director, Digital Health Integrations
Anita.Rao@helixhealth.com
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Anita Rao <anita.rao@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2027 13:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proofpoint acceptance and rollback playbook — MAP milestones & tests

+1 to Anita — I expanded the checklist and added a minimal evidence plan (attached acceptance-checklist-v1.md). Highlights:

- Test run IDs: we will publish a run_id for each test and store the raw logs + model hash in the shared folder.
- Billing snapshot: small script to capture tokens/emitted, which we’ll run during the smoke and load tests; I’ll include a CSV export for procurement.
- Concordance protocol: anonymized 10-case pack and rubric; pass defined as >= 90% agreement with Helix annotations on key clinical entities.
- Rollback steps: 1) switch routing to fallback model variant; 2) revoke delegated keys for the private deployment; 3) open an incident ticket and set a 4-hour remediation SLA for critical safety failures.

I can drive the run on Tue, will upload the acceptance artifacts to the shared drive and post links here immediately after.

— Ben
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineering, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

Attachment: acceptance-checklist-v1.md
